problem_statement: When querying information about a Thread child, the child info structure does not report the CSL (Coordinated Sleep Listening) period of the child. A caller reading the child info cannot obtain the CSL period (in units of 10 symbols) that has been assigned to or retained for the child, nor whether the child is CSL synchronized, even though the underlying child object tracks this value. The CSL period and CSL synchronized state of a child should be reflected in the child info that is populated from the child.
